findings.title: End-to-End Trace Generation via Parametric Sampling
findings.description: While SmolVLM-500M was physically benchmarked on CUDA in INT4 and provided peak VRAM telemetry, the 1,100 per-query traces were evaluated via a calibrated parametric function rather than individual neural network forward passes.
findings.impact: Requires qualification in experimental description; does not alter physical microbenchmark conclusions.

findings.title: Safe Useful Coverage (SUC) Implementation Coupling
findings.description: In src/phase14/experiments.py, SUC is implemented as 'suc = acc if unsupported == 0.0 else 0.0', with unsupported conditioned on acc == 0. This mathematically forces SUC to equal Exact Match Accuracy for all 1,100 records.
findings.impact: SUC reported in Table 10 and Table 12 is numerically identical to Exact Match Accuracy; manuscript must clarify this coupling.

findings.title: 7B FP16 OOM Evaluated via Synthetic Allocation Negative Control
findings.description: The 7B FP16 memory wall was validated via a 16 GB synthetic tensor allocation on CUDA device 0 rather than downloading 15 GB of unquantized Qwen2.5-VL-7B weights.
findings.impact: Physical memory limit is indisputable, but wording should specify allocation negative control rather than runtime model loading.

findings.title: Holm-Bonferroni Correction Function Omitted in Table Generation
findings.description: The function apply_holm_bonferroni was defined and imported, but raw bootstrap p-values were saved directly to table_13_statistical_tests.csv.
findings.impact: Both adjusted p-values remain < 0.001 (0.0002 and 0.0000), leaving hypothesis decisions unchanged.

findings.title: Historical Phase 13 Manifest Scope Boundary
findings.description: The manifest experiments/phase14/frozen_phase13_sha256_manifest.json covers Phase 0-13 (22,162 files) but does not include Phase 14 artifacts.
findings.impact: Phase 14 baseline manifest experiments/phase14_5/checksums/phase14_baseline_sha256.json was generated to protect Phase 14 artifacts.
